title: The Showing the Uneven Pot
youtube_title: The Showing the Uneven Pot | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A shy try, done kindly, is already courage.
summary: At a lantern walk along the evening lane, Delia feels shy about an uneven pot that was still worth showing. Instead of pretending not to care, Delia tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Nana Ruth stays kind and does not push for a show.
